text: DSH Paper Desk 是面向 DSH Web 的论文阅读与研究工作台。它在侧边栏加入“论文”入口，通过 host Remote 服务管理本地项目和文件。用户可以按研究或学习目标建立项目，导入 PDF、浏览和标注页面、生成精读笔记、翻译选中文段并围绕论文提问；还可把论文关联到可编辑的项目脑图并与模型讨论。适合需要整理文献、记录阅读思路和规划研究的 DSH 用户。它使用当前 DSH 配置的模型服务，不需要单独配置 API Key。

DSH Paper Desk adds a Papers workspace to DSH Web. It manages local research projects with PDF uploads, reading, annotations, AI notes, translation, paper chat, and editable mind maps. It helps users organize literature and research ideas, using the active DSH model provider.

DSH Paper Desk 的功能「项目论文库」：按研究或学习项目集中管理论文、标签、笔记和附件。用户可创建项目并上传 PDF，文件与项目元数据保存在本地目录。
DSH Paper Desk 的功能「PDF 精读与标注」：内置 PDF 阅读器支持页面浏览、选中文本、高亮和段落备注；选中文字还可发送翻译或提问请求。
DSH Paper Desk 的功能「AI 精读笔记与共读」：首次打开论文时可根据提取的正文生成结构化 Markdown 笔记，也能带着论文片段、标注和历史记录持续提问。
DSH Paper Desk 的功能「项目脑图」：每个项目可用研究或学习模板建立可编辑节点图，将论文关联到概念，并基于脑图、论文库和选中节点发起模型对话。
DSH Paper Desk 会将提取的论文正文、相关笔记与标注作为上下文发送给当前 DSH 模型服务以生成笔记或回答问题；文件本身保存在本机。

dsh-paper-desk README · Paper Desk · 论文工作台：[](https://github.com/fexas/dsh-paper-desk/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

A Zotero-shaped paper desk for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
It adds a **Papers** entry to the DSH sidebar, a three-pane PDF reader and a
per-project mind map: the normal DSH sidebar on the left, the document or canvas
in the middle, and a DeepSeek chat / Markdown notebook on the right.

> 本项目也适合中文用户：界面、AI 精读笔记和共读对话默认使用中文。

dsh-paper-desk README · Features：- **Projects with a purpose** — choose **Research** (find a problem, build a
  method, compare benchmarks) or **Learning** (build concept dependencies,
  timeline, reading queue and recall exercises). Each project keeps papers,
  tags, annotations, chats, notes and a mind map together.
- **Project mind map** — one persistent React Flow canvas per project, with
  drag-and-drop paper nodes, Markdown/KaTeX nodes, edges, backlinks, automatic
  tidying and a DeepSeek map assistant. Research and learning projects start
  from different templates.
- **Drop PDFs in** — uploads, parses, and files PDFs into a Zotero-style folder
  (`Author et al. - Year - Title`). Title, authors and year are read from the
  PDF metadata and first page.
- **Double-click to read** — click the Read button, or double-click any
  non-interactive part of a paper row.
- **Zotero-shaped paper rows** — expand a paper to see `paper.pdf`, `notes.md`
  and any appendix or supplementary files. Extra files are stored verbatim and
  never parsed.
- **PDF reading** — PDF.js viewer with fit-width/zoom, page navigation,
  selectable text, four highlight colours, paragraph-anchored notes,
  one

dsh-paper-desk README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** with the Web GUI and a DeepSeek provider.
- A modern Chromium-based Web renderer (the DSH Desktop app is supported).
- Node.js **22+** for development builds.

Paper Desk uses the active DSH profile's provider/model. It does not ask for a
separate API key. When provider/model are not configured explicitly it selects
the first DeepSeek Flash/Chat route available in the profile.

dsh-paper-desk README · Install from GitHub：In DSH, open **Settings → Plugins**, install the bundle from GitHub
(`fexas/dsh-paper-desk`), and enable it. Restart DSH if the host asks for a
restart after installing a new package.

If your DSH version exposes the plugin command directly, the equivalent local
checkout flow is:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fexas/dsh-paper-desk.git
cd dsh-paper-desk
npm ci
npm run build

dsh-paper-desk README · Install from GitHub：Then add this directory as a `file:` dependency of the active DSH profile and
select `dsh-paper-desk` in that profile's bundle list (see the
[DSH plugin documentation](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)).
The host half has no build step; `client.js` is the pre-built browser half.

dsh-paper-desk README · Data location：The default data directory depends on how the plugin is installed:

| Install | Default `projects/` location |
|---|---|
| Linked local checkout | `<plugin-root>/projects/` |
| Managed plugin (under `node_modules`) | `$DSH_HOME/paper-desk/projects/` (usually `~/.dsh/paper-desk/projects/`) |

Override it in the plugin row:

```yaml
- id: dsh-paper-desk
  name: dsh-paper-desk
  config:
    provider: deepseek-account

dsh-paper-desk README · Data location：The data directory contains `project.json` plus one folder per paper. Deleting
a project or paper moves it to `projects/.trash/` rather than destroying it.
PDFs, text, notes, annotations and chat history are local files; nothing is
sent anywhere except the model requests made by DeepSeek.

dsh-paper-desk README · How it works：```
browser (client.js)                         host (host/service.js)
──────────────────                         ───────────────────────
React slot UI                              Typert Remote `paperDesk`
PDF.js viewer + KaTeX                      projects/, uploads, files

dsh-paper-desk README · How it works：- `client.js` is a single browser module built from `client/` with esbuild.
  PDF.js, KaTeX fonts and React Flow CSS are bundled, so no CDN or extra asset
  route is needed.
- The host exposes a small `paperDesk` Remote namespace. The browser never gets
  direct filesystem access.
- Every paper is a directory with human-readable JSON/Markdown files; the UI can
  be removed without losing the research library.

dsh-paper-desk README · Project mind map：Every project has a single `mindmap.json`. Open it from the **项目脑图** banner or
the header button in a project.

dsh-paper-desk README · Templates：- **Research** starts with:
  - Motivating example / problem to solve
  - Our methods: framework, motivation / key idea, and why it is superior
  - How to evaluate performance: datasets/benchmarks, metrics, baselines/ablations
- **Learning** starts with:
  - Foundations and prerequisites
  - Core concepts, examples and misconceptions
  - Development timeline
  - Paper queue
  - Recall and exercises

dsh-paper-desk README · Templates：Templates are just seeded nodes. Every title, Markdown body and edge is editable,
and **整理布局** runs a dagre layout for the current graph.

dsh-paper-desk README · Linking papers and ideas：Open **论文库**, then click or drag a paper onto the canvas. A paper node keeps
a stable `paperId`; any node can also reference papers from the node inspector.
The inspector shows incoming backlinks for the selected node, and clicking a
paper chip opens its reader. This gives a lightweight Zettelkasten-style graph:
papers, concepts, questions and experiments live in one canvas and connect in
both directions.

dsh-paper-desk README · Map chat：The right pane switches between **对话** and **节点**:

- **对话** sends the whole graph, the paper library metadata and (optionally)
  the selected node to DeepSeek. The model is explicitly told this is a
  research-strategy or learning-coach session, depending on the project type.
- **节点** edits the selected node's title, type, Markdown body (with formulas),
  linked papers and backlinks.

dsh-paper-desk README · Performance notes：The reader shell opens as soon as the paper record arrives. PDF bytes are read
in eight parallel range requests, page 1 renders before the remaining page
boxes and text layer are resolved, and recently opened PDFs stay in a small
in-memory LRU cache. PDF.js runs its worker bundle on the page thread, which
avoids a Chromium/Electron worker handshake failure that can otherwise hang the
viewer. AI note generation runs alongside PDF loading; a compact progress card
shows the live stage and disappears when the note is written.

dsh-paper-desk README · Development：```bash
npm ci
npm run build      # rebuild client.js
npm run check      # syntax-check host and built client
```

Source layout:

dsh-paper-desk README · Development：- `host/service.js` — projects, chunked uploads, annotations, notes, LLM calls
- `client/App.jsx` — project library, paper rows, reader shell, chat and notes
- `client/PdfViewer.jsx` — PDF.js canvas/text/highlight viewer
- `client/MindMapPage.jsx` — React Flow canvas, paper tray, node inspector and map chat
- `client/markdown.js` — Markdown + KaTeX formula rendering
- `client/styles.css` — DSH-token-based UI styles
- `host/mindmap.js` — research/learning templates and graph normalisation
- `build.mjs` — esbuild bundle, PDF.js worker embedding, inline KaTeX fonts and React Flow CSS

dsh-paper-desk README · Development：Pull requests are welcome. Please keep the UI on DSH theme tokens
(`--dsw-alias-*`) and do not add a separate app shell, CDN dependency or a
second filesystem root.

dsh-paper-desk README · Known limitations：- No OCR: image-only PDFs will not have selectable text or AI full-text context.
- The AI note is generated from extracted PDF text; complex multi-column or
  scanned layouts may lose structure.
- The co-reading chat is a focused paper assistant, not a general-purpose DSH
  agent with tool access.
- Data is local to one machine; there is no sync or multi-user layer.
